column1: # --min_weight=30 fixed. Couples the transfer terms: --wtmul in {150,200,250,
# 300,350} with --wtadd = 150-wtmul, so wm150 has wtadd=0 (pure multiplicative,
# the prior mw30 baseline) and each step pairs a steeper slope with a more
# negative flat offset. Under relative=1 the per-transfer weight is
# wtmul/1000*(src_w-30) + init_w*wtadd/1000, so the negative wtadd subtracts a
# min_weight-independent constant -- and where that drives a transfer <= 0 the
# source is now skipped (see "Skip source when weight transfer is non-positive").
